correctness.rationale: The cubical unordered two-particle Abrams model has vertices unordered vertex pairs, oriented edge–vertex 1-cells and disjoint edge-pair 2-squares. For any 2-cycle, the square coefficients with a fixed cycle edge form a 1-cycle in the graph with that edge’s endpoints removed, hence a forest, forcing them zero. After removing all cycle-edge squares, the remaining off-cycle partner edge graph is a forest, so ∂₂ is injective. Connectedness leaves H0=1, H2=0, and no higher cells. In the rational equivariant chain Grothendieck group C0=Sym²P−P, C1=Q⊗P−F, C2=∧²Q−K, with Q=P−1+ε for a unicyclic graph. Euler and semisimplicity yield H1=ε⊕sum_v ∧²A_v as a rational (not integral or canonical chain-level) module. Standard exterior-square trace identity gives the claimed fixed-halfedge formula. Original verify source was read; independent direct signed cellular/Lefschetz checks for 25 sunlet rotations matched, while all-graph reasoning rests on the forest and Euler proof.
